title: v1 mutating request bodies
description: Request bodies for the control routes. All address a source by its STABLE id (never an index or role name — that strictness is the v1 tightening of the #17 validation). Each route returns the new state (state.schema.json) on success, or the error body (error.schema.json) on failure.

cut.title: POST /api/mxl/v1/cut
cut.description: Hot-cut the given source to program.

source.description: Source id to cut to program. Unknown id -> error.code=unknown_source; valid but not wired -> source_not_attached.

preview.title: POST /api/mxl/v1/preview
preview.description: Arm the given source on the preview bus (pure server-side state; no device call). A later /take cuts it to program.

source.description: Source id to arm on PVW.

take.title: POST /api/mxl/v1/take
take.description: Cut the armed PVW source to PGM. No body. No-op (not an error) if nothing is armed or PVW == PGM.

on.description: true = key up (graphics visible), false = key down.
